text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan suddenly started a live 
broadcast! She called out Daiwa Scarlet 
and Vodka—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A shock announcement: giving up on the 
Tiara route and switching to sprint races! 
Though surprised, her two rivals praise 
her decisive resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheered on by everyone, Aston Machan 
announced her next goal to be the 
Sprinters Stakes. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer hadn't been consulted about 
the change in direction. ...Determined not 
to be left behind by her, they realized 
they had to become someone she could truly 
rely on.
